hand.title: Daily Hand

events.text: You raised before the cards were dealt. Your opponent called.
Flop — Queen, Ace, King. You bet. Your opponent called.
Turn — King. You checked. Your opponent bet — bigger than expected.
River — Ace. Your opponent fired again for value.

wrongReasons: 3 J has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with 3 J.
K 9 makes a full house here — a hand that strong would have raised earlier and pushed harder for maximum value. The measured sizing in this hand points to something weaker.
7 5 has similar strength, but look at when the aggression shifted — the turn card connects with the correct hand in a way it doesn't connect with 7 5.
hand.explanation:
Answer: 7 2

Your opponent called the flop with one pair, then picked up two pair on the turn. The sudden aggression on the turn — after passivity on the flop — is the tell: they improved and immediately started building the pot.
